$comment: Enemies per region. Stats are tuned so the starting zone is survivable bare-handed but slow, and each new region expects the weapon tier the previous one unlocked.

enemies.name: Mire Husk
enemies.description: Waterlogged bark grown around something that used to walk. Slow, and it does not stop.

enemies.name: Pine Stalker
enemies.description: It has been stripping the lower branches. Now it has noticed you.

enemies.name: Ember Wisp
enemies.description: A scrap of the fire that made the flats, still looking for fuel.

enemies.name: Deep Crawler
enemies.description: Armoured in the ore it eats. Hits like the mountain it came out of.

enemies.name: Rift Shade
enemies.description: The storm's idea of a person. It arrives slightly before it moves.
